description: Indian wrestlers shone at the Asian Games, clinching six medals and aiming for Olympic success. A standout performance saw Aman Sehrawat and Sujeet Kalkal grab gold in their categories. Nitesh Siwach made a triumphant comeback with silver, while Deepak Punia took bronze in a new weight class. Antim Panghal secured silver, showing improvement, and Sunil Kumar etched his name in history with a second medal.

Fire breaks out on Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi's 'Ramayana' temporary set
description: A fire erupted on the set of the much-anticipated film 'Ramayana' by Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi in Mumbai. Promptly reported at 4.02 pm, the fire was brought under control by 4.55 pm, with no injuries to cast or crew. The flames disrupted nearby productions like 'Hustle 5' and 'Pati Patni Aur Panga 2', with initial investigations linking the fire's origin to the latter's set.

Beyond the F-35: US, China are racing to build 6th-gen jets that will command drone fleets
description: Sixth-generation fighter aircraft are expected to revolutionize air warfare by incorporating advanced technologies and strong connectivity. Both the US and China are at the forefront of developing these advanced military systems. Collaborations among nations like the UK, Japan, and Italy aim to create powerful multirole aircraft. The shift to network-centric warfare emphasizes the importance of information dominance in future conflicts. As these advancements unfold, traditional combat approaches may evolve significantly.

title: Karnataka DIG frees murder convict using fake SC papers, 'sexually exploits' his wife
description: Somashekhar, a deputy inspector general of Karnataka Prisons, was arrested for serious corruption allegations. The officer was involved in the illegal release of a murderer using forged Supreme Court documents. Additional accusations include sexually exploiting the convict's wife and granting unlawful paroles. He allegedly bypassed prison protocols to favor the convict, which violated established regulations. The investigation highlights extensive misconduct within the prison system during 2018.

title: 'Not mature, beyond limits': Ex-CJI, others slam SC judge's remarks amid SIR row
Dana White family life: Why he made his sons work construction jobs
description: Dana White has shared insights on raising his children and instilling the values of hard work. He made his sons experience manual labor jobs to understand responsibility and discipline. White’s relationship with his late mother was complex and strained, especially after an unauthorised biography. His children have pursued diverse interests, distancing themselves from their father's spotlight in various ways.

title: Akash Anand back in BSP fold after apology to Mayawati, gets key post again
description: BSP national president Mayawati has reinstated her nephew Akash Anand as the national coordinator of the party. His reappointment follows an apology to her regarding his previous actions and a willingness to serve again. Anand had previously faced removal from the BSP due to perceived loyalty conflicts involving family ties. Mayawati emphasized the importance of maintaining discipline within the party and her family's role in that regard.

title: Just Rs 199! India v Uruguay tickets slashed 90% after empty seats for Brazil game
description: In a bid to boost attendance at the upcoming friendly match between India and Uruguay, ticket prices have plummeted from Rs 1,999 to just Rs 199 for select seats. This move follows a lackluster turnout during the Brazil match, which left many seats empty. Furthermore, organisers will distribute around 22,000 complimentary tickets to spectators from a recent event, aiming for a more festive atmosphere at this crucial clash in Kolkata.

title: AAP to skip opposition march to EC office over SIR row
description: Aam Aadmi Party announced they will not participate in the upcoming INDIA bloc protest at the Election Commission. Senior leader Sanjay Singh stated their ongoing protests concerning electoral roll issues are independent. Singh said the party perceives the matter as a people's movement, encouraging citizen participation without AAP's branding. AAP and DMK, previously aligned with the INDIA bloc, have also opted out of its recent meetings.

title: Airfares soar: Delhi-Hyderabad up 68%; IndiGo hikes surcharge by up to Rs 350
description: Data from global aviation analytics firm OAG shows that airlines have scheduled 5% fewer domestic flights for the October-December quarter than during the same period last year. However, total seat capacity has fallen by only 1.2%. This indicates that airlines are operating fewer flights while deploying larger aircraft with more seats, keeping overall capacity relatively steady.

title: Yellowstone letters reveal 1925 explosion story was misplaced by 1,000 feet
description: A captivating century-old enigma surrounds Yellowstone's Biscuit Basin, centering on the misplacement of Black Pearl Geyser. The confusion stemmed from a hydrothermal explosion in 1925, which not only reshaped the landscape but also displaced a key sign. Correspondence from 1926 highlighted the depth of this perplexity related to the geyser's position.

title: Why did AJ Styles return to the ring 246 days after WWE retirement?
description: AJ Styles made a surprising return to the wrestling ring to assist his son, Avery, during a match. Avery was attacked by allies of his opponent, Tristan Moody, after winning by disqualification. Styles, who had recently retired, rushed in to help Avery and fought off the attackers. The emotional moment between father and son highlighted the bond they share as wrestling becomes a family affair.

title: Why children create secret hiding places at home, according to psychology
description: Children often carve out secret spots in their homes to foster a sense of autonomy and belonging. Studies show that these hidden realms not only boost emotional well-being but also spark imaginative adventures. For many kids, these spots symbolize a cherished escape for their personal pursuits. Parents should appreciate their children's quest for privacy while promoting open dialogue.

title: ‘SC scheduled, then cancelled meet’: One Nation, One Election JPC chief amid controversy
description: PP Chaudhary provided clarification about the cancelled meeting set between the parliamentary panel and Supreme Court judges. He stated that the Supreme Court had initially scheduled the meeting for October 6 and later cancelled it. Chaudhary emphasized that previous interactions between parliamentary committees and the judiciary are not without precedent. Former Union minister Kapil Sibal criticized the meeting's constitutionality, arguing it undermined the separation of powers.

title: BJP drops all 8 Uttar Pradesh Rajya Sabha members - what it means
description: The outgoing BJP members, apart from Hardeep Singh Puri and BL Verma, are Arun Singh, Neeraj Shekhar, Geeta Shakya, Brijlal and Seema Dwivedi. The eighth seat belonged to former deputy chief minister Dinesh Sharma, who resigned on September 11 after being appointed lieutenant governor (LG) of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. His term was due to end on November 25, like those of the others.

title: Thailand floods wreak havoc as death toll rises to 31, more rain forecast - video
From ending Korea’s reign to booking Oly quotas: Archers return with bigger target
description: India's archers returned from the Asian Games with a record tally of medals and Olympic qualifications. The compound and recurve teams showcased impressive performances, leading to significant victories. A number of young athletes contributed to the success, demonstrating a narrowing gap with global competitors. The systematic preparations and supportive structures played a vital role in their achievements.

title: Deshaun Watson’s $6.9m mansion: What is inside his 17,000 sq ft home?
description: Quarterback Deshaun Watson has invested in a stunning mansion in Hunting Valley, marking a significant homecoming after his time in Houston. Spanning more than 17,000 square feet, the estate offers lavish features including a large swimming pool, tennis courts, and a 12-seater theater. This acquisition follows Watson’s lucrative contract signing with the Cleveland Browns, showcasing his rising stature in the NFL.

title: Heavy rain throws Bengaluru into chaos: Waterlogging grips key roads
description: Bengaluru experienced heavy rains on Monday, causing significant waterlogging on major roads and traffic disruptions. Areas like KR Puram Metro station and Tin Factory faced intense rainfall and slow-moving traffic. Visibility decreased sharply, leading motorists to use headlights during the downpour. Water accumulation was also problematic near the Geddalahalli railway bridge and on Old Madras Road. The heavy rain affected daily commuting, especially in low-lying areas across the city.

title: In a first, UP opt for split captaincy and coaching for upcoming domestic season
description: Uttar Pradesh are set to split their captaincy and coaching responsibilities between red-ball and white-ball cricket. Aryan Juyal and Gyanendra Pandey will lead the Ranji setup, while Karan Sharma and Sudip Tyagi will handle the white-ball teams. Yash Dayal, Zeeshan Ansari and Abhinandan Singh are among the notable names in the Ranji squad.

title: UK couple won £1m on EuroMillions; days later, their baby arrived a month early
description: In February 2019, Natalie and Andrew Symes unexpectedly won £1 million in the EuroMillions lottery. Shortly after their win, they welcomed their daughter Poppy a month earlier than expected. The couple used their winnings to buy a home and relieve financial pressure during lockdowns. Natalie's ability to stay home with the children has been a significant change in their lives.

title: Kansas neighbour cut 133 trees; court upholds $6,500 damages award
description: A Kansas appeals court has upheld a $6,500 damages award against a man whose neighbour’s fence project led to 133 trees being cut on adjoining land in 2015. The court found the landowner filed his trespass case within the legal time limit and that there was enough evidence to hold Douglas Black responsible for the tree damage.

title: Valtteri Bottas’ 350km cycling challenge: Why is he riding to Singapore?
description: Valtteri Bottas has embarked on a 350km cycling journey from Kuala Lumpur International Airport to Singapore. He aims to complete this challenge before the upcoming Singapore Grand Prix. Bottas previously faced setbacks during the Malaysian Grand Prix, where he retired after crashing. His cycling serves both as training and a mental reset after the disappointing race. If successful, he will arrive on time for his media commitments.

title: Scientists find cheaper way to make clean hydrogen from water using light
France school protests: 15-year-old student loses hand in stun grenade incident
description: Protests in France have intensified due to teacher shortages, resulting in widespread school closures and clashes. A 15-year-old student lost his hand after handling a police stun grenade, prompting a government investigation. Police reported numerous arrests and significant property damage since the protests began last week. Student unions continue to organise demonstrations despite concerns over escalating violence.

title: Florida's Burmese pythons are carrying three previously unknown RNA viruses
‘Don’t invest just because everyone else is,’ says Sebi chief; flags investor frauds
100 fighter jets part of op 'Yemen Dawn' to wrest Red Sea from Houthis
description: Saudi military spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Malki said the coalition was providing “full operational support” to government forces. He said around 100 fighter jets were supporting the campaign and that the coalition had established “air protection” over the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The coalition also claimed to have destroyed hundreds of Houthi targets. Those claims, however, could not be independently verified.

title: 5,000-year-old Egyptian skulls reveal new evidence of retainer sacrifice
description: Researchers re-examininf 46 skulls excavated from Egypt’s First Dynasty royal cemetery at Abydos, found significant cranial trauma in 18 of them. The injuries provide new forensic evidence that some people buried around royal tombs may have been deliberately killed after a ruler’s death. The findings support the possibility of retainer sacrifice, although the exact cause of death remains uncertain for many others.

title: Ram Gopal Varma reacts to AI-morphed 'Chuttamalle' video controversy
description: Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma has weighed in on the uproar regarding the AI-morphed video of 'Chuttamalle'. He argues that discussing such content merely increases its visibility and diverts attention from the fundamental issue at hand. Actor Jr NTR and actress Janhvi Kapoor have both criticized the inappropriate video, stressing the necessity of consent and respect in artistic expressions.

title: New Jersey data center spills 5,000 gallons of diesel; mayor cites 'computer glitch'
description: A New Jersey data center spilled thousands of gallons of diesel fuel into a tributary of the Hackensack River. The incident occurred on September 11 and involved a reported 5,000 gallons from a storage tank. Equinix confirmed that two broken valves caused the release while the mayor attributed it to a computer glitch. Clean-up crews removed about 3,500 gallons during the operation, without impacting local wildlife.

title: Man paid Rs 1.73 cr for Gurgaon flat, waited for a decade; commission orders refund + 12% interest
description: In 2012, the man booked the 2,600 sq ft apartment in a project located in Sector 83, Gurgaon. The basic sale price was fixed at Rs 6,428.50 per sq ft, apart from other applicable charges. The basic sale price of the apartment was stipulated at Rs 1.67 crore. Relying on the assurances given by the developer, the man obtained a home loan and ultimately paid Rs 1,72,93,048.76 towards the apartment.

title: 'Country moving in democratic way': BJP on SC notice to EC, govt on pleas against CEC
'Beaten to death by husband': 5-yr-old found playing with dolls beside mother’s body
description: In a tragic incident, a five-year-old girl was discovered playing near her mother's body in Vaishali district. The child's mother, Asha Devi, was reportedly beaten to death by her husband following a dispute. Family members learned of the incident after a neighbor alerted them about the situation. The police have initiated a search for Sujit, Asha's husband, who allegedly fled the scene.

title: Giant pumpkin wins BC contest by just 1 pound after weighing 1,485 pounds
description: Kelowna grower Jordan Abbate won the 2026 B.C. Giant Pumpkin Contest with a 1,485-pound pumpkin, beating the runner-up by just one pound. The victory followed six months of daily care, including watering, pruning and soil preparation. The contest also saw two new B.C. records in other giant vegetable categories.

title: BJP announces 8 candidates for Rajya Sabha polls in UP; Puri, BL Verma not on list
description: BJP has announced eight candidates for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections in Uttar Pradesh. Union ministers Hardeep Puri and BL Verma were not included in this announcement. The election schedule was previously announced by the Election Commission of India. Meanwhile, the Samajwadi Party has designated two candidates for these polls as well. The final date for filing nominations will be October 6, followed by polling on October 16.

title: NEET UG among world’s 5 largest exams with 25 lakh applications
description: NEET UG has ranked as the world’s fifth-largest examination by applications, with around 25 lakh registrations, according to SBI Research. The report places China’s Gaokao at the top with 1.29 crore candidates. UPSC CSE, JEE Main and UGC NET also feature among major global examinations, highlighting the scale, security and contingency challenges involved in conducting tests for millions of candidates.

title: 'Modified Form 6 not approved by us': What SC said on EC decisions linked to SIR
SC seeks EC response on changes during SIR: Why Form 6 has become a flashpoint
description: A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Bagchi and Mohana sought responses from the Election Commission, the Centre, the CEC and the other two election commissioners before examining whether the poll panel's statutory procedure was followed. The bench refused to pass an immediate order seeking the suspension of  CEC , while considering the controversy over Form 6, which was one of the central issues raised in the petitions.

title: 2021 injury row: Mamata's lawyer sends notice to hospitals over record 'disclosure'
description: Mamata Banerjee's lawyer issued a legal notice to two hospitals over "unauthorised" medical record disclosures. This followed allegations made by West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari about her 2021 leg injury. Adhikari claimed that her injury was "faked" during the assembly elections, where she campaigned from a wheelchair. The notice sought clarification on how her medical records were revealed without permission.

title: Meta lets go Virtue AI founders 4 months after hiring them: Here’s what company said
description: Meta has parted ways with several employees from the acquired startup Virtue AI after only four months. Co-founders Bo Li, Dawn Song, and Sanmi Koyejo were among those let go due to workplace differences. This decision reflects ongoing challenges in enhancing AI safety and security within the company. The hiring aimed to strengthen Meta's capabilities as concerns about advanced AI systems grow.

title: Travis Kelce-backed Six Flags: How is its $20.8M solar project going green?
description: Travis Kelce-backed Six Flags is making a major sustainability move as Magic Mountain’s new solar parking project powers two parks. The 12.37 MW installation covers 4,315 spaces and is expected to generate 20.8 million kWh annually. The project also includes an 8 MWh battery and 109 EV charging stations. Kelce joined Six Flags as a 2026 brand ambassador, adding star power to the company’s latest green initiative.

title: Caitlin Clark’s Excel connection: Why is Linda Cohn questioning the WNBA?
description: Excel Search & Advisory is helping the NBA find Cathy Engelbert’s successor as WNBA commissioner. Because Excel Sports Management represents Caitlin Clark and Napheesa Collier, former ESPN host Linda Cohn has questioned how the company will separate its executive search work from player representation. The NBA has not publicly detailed specific safeguards, while Adam Silver remains involved in the final decision.
